name: omnintent-monorepo
description: Omnintent: describe your app's actions once, generate Siri App Intents, Android AppFunctions, and a remote MCP server.

scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w omnintent && npm run typecheck -w todo-example-mcp
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run typecheck && vitest run
scripts.generate:example: node packages/cli/dist/cli.js generate examples/todo/omnintent.json --target all --out examples/todo/generated
scripts.xcode:check: npm run build && node scripts/xcode-build-check.mjs examples/todo/omnintent.json packages/cli/test/fixtures/swift/TodoExampleHandlers.swift && node scripts/xcode-build-check.mjs packages/cli/test/fixtures/swift/coverage.json
